subject.title: Unified env var management: .env should be the single source of truth

question: Should managed gateway restarts make state-dir `.env` authoritative over generated service-env values, or should current daemon/process-env precedence remain with clearer warnings/docs/doctor repair?
rationale: Both paths are plausible, but the choice changes credential precedence and service restart behavior for existing managed installs, so automation should not pick it.

options.title: Keep precedence, add warning/docs
options.body: Keep process/service env as higher precedence and add explicit conflict diagnostics plus docs or doctor guidance for stale generated service-env values.

options.title: Make `.env` authoritative on restart
options.body: Rebuild or sync managed service env from state-dir `.env` during restart/reinstall, with upgrade tests for LaunchAgent, systemd, and Windows task behavior.

options.title: Doctor-only repair path
options.body: Leave restart behavior unchanged but make `openclaw doctor --fix` the documented recovery path for stale generated service-env values.

recommendation.title: Keep precedence, add warning/docs
recommendation.body: Keep process/service env as higher precedence and add explicit conflict diagnostics plus docs or doctor guidance for stale generated service-env values.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is mostly a product/security config contract choice, and steipete has the strongest service-env/config contract history in the inspected commits.
